content.title: WA homebuyers increasingly turn to riskier adjustable-rate mortgages | The Seattle Times

(Karen Ducey / The Seattle Times, 2025) Skip Ad By Alexis Weisend Seattle Times business reporter With persisting high mortgage rates and home prices, more Washington homebuyers — especially in King County — are turning to a riskier type of loan that was last popular leading up to the 2008 financial crisis.Adjustable-rate mortgages, loans that start with a lower fixed interest rate than other mortgages for several years before eventually moving with the market, are gaining popularity across the United States as economic conditions tighten.
